product.description: A selection of frozen foods and instant meals for convenient cooking and consumption.

product.description: Bakery items and desserts including mooncakes, ice cream, and traditional Asian pastries available online.

product.name: Snacks and Beverages
product.description: A variety of ethnic snacks and beverages available for online purchase and delivery.
